result: Keynote was separated from Description: Description identifies the material variant; Keynote is the documentation identity. Existing keys remain authoritative. A new local suffix system may be generated only when the user explicitly requests creation of a new project keynote set.
problem: The alphabetic suffix after a classification section is not inherently an official semantic code and must not be treated as one without an authoritative keynote table.
found_by: Existing material schedules contained repeated section-based keys with local suffixes that did not expose a universal letter meaning.
